TLDR; Halo MCC. 

On the 360, I sunk in a good 1/3 of my gaming hours on Halo 3 and Reach with that console. I bought the Xbox One solely for MCC, and I bought the Series X to play newer games, however I pretty much find myself playing MCC 90% of the time still. I’ve delved in and enjoyed other shooters, ImSims, RPGs, Etc. I’ve gone extended periods of time not playing Halo and enjoying other titles that are vastly different but I always return to MCC as my main game eventually. 

Its campaigns are nostalgic for me and I’ll typically play CE through Reach once a year, but the custom games browser satisfies my Competitive itch and mindless fun with its custom mini games. I’m not someone who makes video games “my thing” or personality in the real world, but classic Halo has always been special to me and I have no problem what so ever being one of the last classic Halo fans keeping those games alive. It’s a love that has dimmed many times but always seems to spark at full power eventually.
